note: Wikimedia Commons, “St.Makarij diakon.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Ієром. Іринарх та учні — fetched 04 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons' own description reads «Ікона прп.Макарія Диякона. XIX ст.» — a nineteenth-century icon of Venerable Macarius the Deacon — and the file sits in Commons' category 'Saints of Kyiv Caves Monastery'. Deacon and Caves together are this folder exactly: the Russian calendar prints him «Преподобный Макарий Печерский, диакон» for 19 January old style, and this folder's own name note says the rank word «диакон» is the only thing the calendar uses to tell him from the faster Macarius of the same house, whom the same day keeps. He is not either of the Macarii the same day carries from Egypt and Alexandria: the Zhitiya Svyatykh plates 05191 and 05192 name those two in full and neither is of the Caves. Commons describes it: Ікона прп.Макарія Диякона. XIX ст.
